name: backroom
title: Backroom: NeuroClaw and an Ollama model (Gemma) talking until stopped
description: Adds files only; changes no core file and adds no third-party code. NeuroClaw and an Ollama-hosted model converse until stopped; new lines go to memory and the prose predictor, and a labelled "unverified" digest is published every 50 new lines. Run with: node scripts/backroom.mjs. See docs/BACKROOM.md.
